definitions.explanation: A person who composes waka ({和歌|わか}) or tanka ({短歌|たんか}), traditional Japanese poetry forms. Used both historically for classical poets and for modern tanka practitioners.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{歌人|かじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: To read the works of a famous waka poet.

examples.japanese: {紀貫之|きのつらゆき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{平安|へいあん}→平安：12641_heian⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{歌人|かじん}だ。
examples.english: Ki no Tsurayuki is a representative waka poet of the Heian period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歌人|かじん}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{短歌|たんか}→短歌：15358_tanka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}み{出|だ}している→生み出す：10423_umidasu⟧。
examples.english: Modern tanka poets are creating new tanka using everyday language.

notes:
Specifically refers to a poet who writes ⟦{和歌|わか}→和歌：05230_waka⟧ (waka) or ⟦{短歌|たんか}→短歌：15358_tanka⟧ (tanka), the traditional 31-syllable Japanese poem form. Composed of {歌|か} (song/poem) + ⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧ (person).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歌人|かじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歌集|かしゅう}→歌集：29498_kashuu⟧: a poet's collection of tanka
- ⟦{近代|きんだい}→近代：02663_kindai⟧{歌人|かじん}: modern-era waka poet
- {女流|じょりゅう}{歌人|かじん}: female waka poet
- ⟦{宮廷|きゅうてい}→宮廷：12526_kyuutei⟧{歌人|かじん}: court poet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{俳人|はいじん}→俳人：09569_haijin⟧: haiku poet — a poet who writes haiku
- ⟦{詩人|しじん}→詩人：03171_shijin⟧: poet — a general term for any poet, especially those writing modern free verse
- ⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧: singer — a different word entirely, not to be confused with {歌人|かじん}

USAGE:
Do not confuse {歌人|かじん} with the homophone ⟦{佳人|かじん}→佳人：18337_kajin⟧ (a beautiful woman). The {歌人|かじん} tradition stretches from the ⟦{万葉集|まんようしゅう}→万葉集：08827_manyoushuu⟧ era to the present day, with modern {歌人|かじん} continuing to innovate within the 5-7-5-7-7 syllable form.
